inbound.d: directed or moving inward or toward a center

inbuilt.d: existing as an essential constituent or characteristic

inbreeding.d: the act of mating closely related individuals

inboard.d: located within the hull or nearest the midline of a vessel or aircraft

inborn error of metabolism.d: any of a number of diseases in which an inherited defect (usually a missing or inadequate enzyme) results in an abnormality of metabolism
